description: EMPRESAS DE TRANSPORTE DE CARGA TERRESTRE - RISARALDA is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Risaralda, Risaralda. Este conjunto de datos contiene información sobre las empresas dedicadas al transporte de carga terrestre ubicadas en el departamento de Risaralda, Colombia. Incluye datos como la razón social, el NIT, el municipio de operación, el código del municipio, el tipo de actividad económica, y la forma jurídica de la empresa. Coverage: Gobernación de Risaralda, Risaralda. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Risaralda, Risaralda. Its tags are carga, empresas, transporte. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Transporte. The portal shows 2025-09-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
